title: Effect · hover-rise (CTA halo + inner bottom glow)
description: Brand interaction primitive — standard CTA outer halo plus bottom-centered inner glow that fades in on hover (and on keyboard focus-visible for a11y). No DOM of its own; the effect is applied via CSS pseudo-elements to a set of brand selectors (.btn-primary-ring, .btn-secondary-filled, .nav-link, .nav-trigger, .locale-trigger, .bc-link for the header breadcrumb) and opt-in via [data-fx="rise"] for custom elements. Tinted by --fx-rise-color, defaulting to --cta-accent (which the page's data-vertical overlay can re-theme). Uses the same radial contract as cta.btn-primary-ring and cta.btn-secondary-filled: ellipse 58% 78% at 50% 100%, transparent at 60%.

source.primary: servicewand.com .button::after + winter-services .vl-button::after (both inject --button-bg via JS at first hover)
source.adapted_from: Reproduced as pure CSS gradient — no external image. Generalized to a set of brand selectors + opt-in attribute so the same effect applies to nav links, locale, breadcrumb, and any custom enrolled element. Updated to match the 2026-05-25 CTA glow contract.
source.decision: PM lock 2026-05-22 — hover-rise is a brand-level interaction primitive (not button-specific). One CSS file, broad selector list, tint via --cta-accent.

notes: Auto-applied selectors: .btn-primary-ring, .btn-secondary-filled, .nav-link, .nav-trigger, .locale-trigger, .bc-link. Their host blocks list effect.hover-rise in depends_on.other_blocks so a CMS generator knows to import this CSS whenever any of those appear on the page.
Opt-in: add data-fx="rise" to any custom interactive element to enroll it. The element must be position: relative (the rule sets it explicitly via :where() so it works automatically).

Tint: --fx-rise-color > --cta-accent > #6BEAF9 (fallback chain). Set --fx-rise-color on a specific element to override per-element; set --cta-accent on a section/page to re-theme everything inside it.

Stacking: the ::after sits at z-index 1 inside the host. Host's direct children are bumped to z-index 2 so the effect stays behind content. Host gets overflow: hidden to keep the glow contained. Outer halo uses box-shadow 0 0 32px -4px.
Accessibility: activates on :focus-visible too, so keyboard users see the same affordance. Reduced-motion removes the opacity transition but keeps the effect.
The hover opacity caps at 0.48 to match the canonical CTA inner glow. Adjust per-element with .my-class::after { opacity: ... } if needed.
